title: One average, two layouts
predict: Five columns, 10,000 rows. How much does each layout read to answer one average?
caption: SELECT avg(price) on 10,000 rows: the row store reads every row whole and discards three columns; the column store opens two files. With 100 columns it is 100 against 2.

title: When "saved" and "shown" happen
predict: Persistence lags ten minutes. On which path does a refresh hide a message you already saw?
caption: One message sent three ways: ① saved, then shown; ② shown at once and saved after the Kafka lag, so a refresh inside the lag hides it; ③ shown and never saved.

title: Links grow, then collapse into one pipe
predict: Add a fifth server. How many new links does the mesh need, and how many does the Pub/Sub need?
caption: Each new server must link to every other, so the links and each server's wasted slots climb; a real-time Pub/Sub in the middle leaves one link per server and keeps nothing.

title: Lost in real time, fixed by a timer
predict: WS2 blinked for one second while A posted. When does E see the message?
caption: The message is stored through Kafka, but Redis pushes it while WS2 is disconnected and keeps nothing; E's client fetches the last 50 on a timer and the message appears.
